description: B2 WALLS, DOOR DELETED (WINDOW-DOOR edit 3; buildings.md B2 Edits): b2-walls-door-window without the door: the front wall has 10 full studs and one 144 bottom plate again (exactly the no-openings front wall); the window stays. model.json is EXACTLY the four walls' expansions with the member materials documents applies (no part default); members.json is each body's member metadata. packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_wall.py asserts both files are the plugins' output; services/geometry/tests/test_walls_b2.py checks the cut list, that the exported STEP's solids are buildings.md's members box for box, that none enters a rough opening, and interference none.
derivation: Every expectation except the mesh counts is ANALYTIC, from the members typed from buildings.md's coordinates in test_walls_b2.py's spec_boxes (front wall Y 0..3.5 and back Y 116.5..120 along X 0..144, side walls X 0..3.5 and 140.5..144 along Y 3.5..116.5; bottom plates Z 0..1.5, studs and kings 1.5..94.125, top plates 94.125..97.125; door jacks Z 1.5..82.5, header plies Z 82.5..88 at the wall's two faces, top cripples 88..94.125; window sill Z 44.5..46, bottom cripples 1.5..44.5), summed in exact rational arithmetic (x 25.4 = mm exactly), never from the plugin.
volume = 440805/16 in^3 (57 boxes; the spec's wall cut list summed: see VOLUMES in test_walls_b2.py) x 25.4^3 = 451468734.1575 mm^3.
surface_area = sum of 2(ab + bc + ca) over the 57 boxes (bodies are separate, touching faces are not merged) = 52993 in^2 = 34188963.88 mm^2.
centroid = volume-weighted mean of the box centres (exact rationals): x = 45237713/587740 in, y = 8814882/146935 in, z = 24773769/470192 in.

mass_g = (SPF volume x 450 + PT volume x 582) kg/m^3, the PT being the bottom plates (514 in x 5.25 in^2), the rest SPF = 208998.035341803 g; center_of_mass x = 183369273/2386684 in, y = 680113590/11336749 in, z = 9293962863/181387984 in.
topology: 57 boxes x (6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell) = 342 faces, 684 edges, 57 shells.
MESH counts are recorded but also exact for boxes: 12 triangles and 24 vertices per box = 684 triangles, 1368 vertices.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), as b2-walls-no-openings-16oc: the bounds are ABSOLUTE and the part is ~4.7e8 mm^3, so the double-precision sum of its separate bodies carries round-off near the ULP of the sum (~6e-8). Measured 2026-10-17 over the four WINDOW-DOOR goldens: 1.8e-7 mm^3 at worst on the volume, 1.5e-8 mm^2 on the area, <= 1.6e-12 mm on the centroid and <= 1.9e-12 mm on the centre of mass, 1.2e-10 g on the mass. 1e-6 is 5.6x the worst and ~2e-15 relative; a member 0.001 in out of place moves the volume by >= 1.2 mm^3 and fails by six orders of magnitude.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-17: the STEP round trip re-sums the re-imported solids in another order and moves the VOLUME by 7.2e-7 mm^3 at worst over the four WINDOW-DOOR goldens (door deleted; 6.0e-7 with the door and window, 3.6e-7 window 30, 2.4e-7 door moved), ~1.5e-15 relative, the AREA by 0 and the centroid by <= 2.7e-12 mm. That is above ROUNDTRIP_TOL (1e-7 absolute), which is near the ULP of a 4.7e8 sum. 3e-6 is 4.2x the worst. Same cause as b2-walls-no-openings-16oc; it applies to volume and area only, centroid and bounds keep ROUNDTRIP_TOL.
